'''FC Vitia''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi Futbollistik Vitia}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Viti, Kosovo|Viti]], in southeastern [[Kosovo]]. Founded in 2010, the club has primarily competed in the lower divisions of the Kosovan football league system, with its highest sustained level being the [[First Football League of Kosovo|second tier]].

After winning promotion from the [[Second Football League of Kosovo|third tier]] in its debut season, Vitia spent several years in the First League, achieving a best finish of fourth place in Group B in the [[2020–21 First Football League of Kosovo|2020–21 campaign]]. Relegation followed in 2022, and after another drop from the third tier, the club ceased to appear in official competition.<ref>{{cite news |title=FC Vitia: We were kicked out of the league because we did not submit to FFK |url=https://indeksonline.net/en/fc-vitia-rame-nga-liga-se-nuk-iu-nenshtruam-ffk-se-1/ |access-date=25 July 2025 |work=Indeks Online |date=14 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250725214955/https://indeksonline.net/en/fc-vitia-rame-nga-liga-se-nuk-iu-nenshtruam-ffk-se-1/ |archive-date=25 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Moslicencimi i FFK-së, iniciohet thirrja e Kuvendit të Jashtëzakonshëm të FFK-së |url=https://gazetainfokus.com/moslicencimi-i-ffk-se-iniciohet-thirrja-e-kuvendit-te-jashtezakonshem-te-ffk-se/ |access-date=25 July 2025 |work=Infokus |date=3 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250725215938/https://gazetainfokus.com/moslicencimi-i-ffk-se-iniciohet-thirrja-e-kuvendit-te-jashtezakonshem-te-ffk-se/ |archive-date=25 July 2025 |language=sq |trans-title=Non-licensing of FFK triggers call for Extraordinary General Assembly}}</ref>"}}
